mechanism: Amphotericin B causes significant nephrotoxicity and hypokalemia, while prednisone increases infection risk and can potentiate electrolyte losses, creating synergistic adverse effects.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes (especially potassium and magnesium), and blood pressure closely; use liposomal amphotericin B formulation if possible to reduce nephrotoxicity; maintain adequate hydration and consider potassium supplementation.
